evidence.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 天津古籍出版社／遼寧人民出版社, 2012, ISBN 9787552800692
evidence.field: 日部 entry, printed p. 599 / PDF p. 612; directly inspected supplied scan pixels. Checked the 日 headword, glyph sequence and prose through the entry's end.
evidence.text: The entry identifies 日 as pictographic, saying its initial form resembled the sun and that later writing changed rounded strokes to angular ones. It calls the sun the graph's basic meaning and proposes later extensions including sunlight, day, daylight, time and ruler. This is the book author's proposed account; the cited material does not by itself establish the order or every semantic transition.
evidence.title: 字源

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Revised Mandarin Dictionary, via 教育百科
evidence.field: 日 entry, senses 1–10; entry identifies its source as 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》
evidence.text: The entry lists 日 rì as sun, daytime, a day, daily, and other senses. It also explicitly lists 日 as an abbreviation for Japan, with examples 日貨 and 中日條約. The dictionary confirms this as a recorded Chinese sense; it does not establish when the abbreviation originated.
evidence.kind: official dictionary entry reproduced by Taiwan Ministry of Education education portal
evidence.title: 日 的意思、注音與解釋 | 教育百科

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Concise Mandarin Dictionary
evidence.text: Lists 日本的簡稱 (“abbreviation for Japan”) and gives 日貨 and 中日條約 as examples. This supports the abbreviation as a contemporary Chinese dictionary sense; the entry does not date its origin.
evidence.title: 教育部《國語辭典簡編本》：日

search_audit.outcome: Search results led to the Taiwan Ministry of Education education portal reproducing the Revised Mandarin Dictionary entry, and to the Concise Mandarin Dictionary entry. Opened the education portal and inspected its 日 senses, including the Japan abbreviation, plus present-day sun and daytime senses. Opened the Revised Dictionary URL, but it returned no readable entry text in the web tool; the portal itself identifies that dictionary as its source. The Concise Dictionary URL opened in the portal-rendered content and its sense 7 was inspected.

gaps: [SCAN VERIFICATION REQUIRED] 字源, PDF p. 612 / printed p. 599, quoted 說文 span “从口、一”: the printed enclosure appears 口-shaped, but consulted transcriptions read 从囗一. The scan pixels do not settle the printed graph's identity; retain this occurrence unresolved and do not normalize it.
